title: Gemini Robotics 2.5
lede: Google DeepMind's new vision-language-action model maps what a robot sees and hears into arm and hand motion, with large gains on dexterous tasks and a factory pilot on humanoid robots.

points: DeepMind reports success rates 30% to 100% above the previous baseline, with tasks finished 20% to 30% faster.
It was tested on more than 200 tasks involving tools, cloth, ribbon and delicate items.
Some skills went from near zero to usable, such as closing a toolbox lid, up from 0% to 93%.
Apptronik's Apollo 2 humanoids reached 96% success sorting parts into trays on Mercedes-Benz lines in Hungary and Germany, framed as a pilot.
Run-time safety reasoning raised safe completions near obstacles and people, and DeepMind open-sourced ASIMOV-Jailbreak, a benchmark of disguised unsafe prompts.

sections.text: Robotics and embodied-AI teams. It is rolling out to DeepMind's robotics partners and runs across robot types, including the Franka Duo two-arm platform.
